title: 26 U.S. Code 6656, Failure to make deposit of taxes
issuer: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School (U.S. Code text)

passages.question: What does the law charge for a late deposit, and what excuses it?
passages.excerpt: Unless it is shown that such failure is due to reasonable cause and not due to willful neglect, there shall be imposed upon such person a penalty equal to the applicable percentage of the amount of the underpayment. ... (i) 2 percent if the failure is for not more than 5 days, (ii) 5 percent if the failure is for more than 5 days but not more than 15 days, and (iii) 10 percent if the failure is for more than 15 days.
